seedMessages.text: Hi! Ask me anything about Indian Standards.
Is BIS certification mandatory for two-wheeler helmets?
Yes. Protective helmets for two-wheeler riders must conform to the BIS safety specification, and manufacturers are required to hold a valid BIS licence (ISI mark) before sale.

citations.title: Protective Helmets for Two-Wheeler Riders — Specification

seedMessages.text: What is the required thread pitch for M8 bolts used in solar mounting structures?
I don't have a verified standard for this — please check with the BIS helpdesk.
Do household electrical appliances need BIS certification?
Yes, household electrical appliances must comply with the applicable BIS safety standard before they can be sold.

mockReplies.text: The BIS Hallmark on gold jewellery certifies purity and is mandatory for retailers under the Hallmarking Scheme.

mockReplies.text: Packaged drinking water sold in India must be certified under the mandatory BIS scheme before it can be marketed.
Pressure cookers manufactured or sold in India must carry the ISI mark under this specification.
Yes. Toys sold in India must comply with the BIS safety standard covering mechanical and physical hazards, and manufacturers need a valid BIS licence (ISI mark) before sale.
